checks.name: Connect offers private code and a personal Google key with clear billing and retention
Switching methods and closing clears entered credentials
Personal key creates only an opaque HttpOnly session and clears the key field
Lessons use the personal provider and never save keys with memory
Reload retains key-session access without storing or asking for the key again
Browser microphone audio, transcription and lessons use only the personal provider
Switching to host code uses host quota while preserving saved lessons
Disconnect removes live access and retains local saved learning
